description: This file defines a React hook named useDebouncedCallback that creates and returns a debounced version of a callback function. It manages internal references and effects to provide a stable, delayed invocation mechanism, useful for optimizing performance by limiting the rate of function calls.

methods.name: useDebouncedCallback(fn, wait = 300)
methods.description: Creates a stable debounced function that delays invoking the provided function until after a specified wait time has elapsed since the last call.
